parameters.jsCode: const c=$input.first().json;if(!['demo','live'].includes(c.mode))throw Error('mode must be demo or live');if(c.mode==='live'&&c.allowPaidProcessing!==true)throw Error('Set allowPaidProcessing=true after reviewing provider cost');if(c.mode==='live'&&!/^https:\/\/[a-z0-9.-]+(?:\/[a-zA-Z0-9._~:/?#[\]@!$&'()*+,;=%-]*)?$/.test(c.providerBaseUrl))throw Error('Use an HTTPS provider URL');if(!Array.isArray(c.jobs)||c.jobs.length<1||c.jobs.length>5)throw Error('Use 1-5 jobs');const seen=new Set();for(const j of c.jobs){if(!/^[a-z0-9_-]{1,64}$/i.test(j.jobId)||seen.has(j.jobId))throw Error('Unique safe jobId required');seen.add(j.jobId);if(j.rightsConfirmed!==true||typeof j.rightsReference!=='string'||j.rightsReference.trim().length<6)throw Error('Ownership or permission evidence is required');if(!/^https:\/\//.test(j.videoUrl))throw Error('videoUrl must use HTTPS');if(!Array.isArray(j.regions)||j.regions.length<1||j.regions.length>8)throw Error('Use 1-8 removal regions');for(const r of j.regions){for(const k of ['startSeconds','endSeconds','x','y','width','height'])if(!Number.isFinite(r[k]))throw Error('Region values must be numeric');if(r.startSeconds<0||r.endSeconds<=r.startSeconds||r.endSeconds-r.startSeconds>600)throw Error('Invalid region time range');for(const k of ['x','y','width','height'])if(r[k]<0||r[k]>1)throw Error('Region coordinates use 0-1 ratios');if(r.x+r.width>1||r.y+r.height>1)throw Error('Region exceeds frame bounds');}}return [{json:c}];

const inputs=$input.all(),requests=$('Build provider requests').all();return inputs.map((item,n)=>{const r=requests[n].json,status=Number(item.json.statusCode||0),body=item.json.body||{};let state='unknown';if(status===200||status===201||status===202)state=body.jobId?'queued':'invalid_response';else if(status>=400&&status<500)state='rejected';else if(status>=500)state='provider_error';return {json:{...r,providerJobId:body.jobId||null,state,httpStatus:status,attempt:0,lastBody:body,warning:state==='unknown'||state==='provider_error'?'Check provider billing before retrying; POST retries are disabled.':null},pairedItem:{item:n}};});

parameters.content:
## Purpose
Queue up to five watermark-cleanup jobs only after ownership or editing permission has been recorded. Every job carries normalized frame regions, an idempotency key, a rights reference, bounded status polling and a final audit manifest. It is designed for lawful cleanup of the user's own or licensed footage, not removal of third-party ownership marks.

## Setup
The default demo is offline and produces a completed fixture without credentials or network calls. For live use, replace providerBaseUrl with your authorized processing API, configure n8n Header Auth on both HTTP nodes, review its request/response contract and set allowPaidProcessing to true. Keep secrets in n8n credentials. The expected API accepts POST /jobs and returns jobId, then GET /jobs/{jobId} with processing, completed or failed plus an optional resultUrl.

## Safety and recovery
Each job needs rightsConfirmed=true and a meaningful rightsReference. One to eight time-bounded rectangular regions use 0-1 frame ratios and are rejected if they cross frame boundaries. POST retries are disabled to avoid duplicate charges. Polling is capped; unknown or provider-error outcomes require checking the provider dashboard before retrying. The workflow never downloads, republishes or deletes media automatically.

## Output
The final node emits one audit record per job with provider ID, terminal state, attempts, result URL and rights evidence reference. Review cleaned footage frame-by-frame and confirm that licensed logos, credits or attribution required by contract remain intact before publishing.

## Attribution
Created by Shisan Hua, who works on [Video Watermark Remover](https://videowatermarkremover.org/). The template uses a generic authorized provider contract and does not claim a public Video Watermark Remover API.
